channel.title: Lemuel Owusu-Ansah — Blog
channel.description: Thoughts on building software, running a studio, writing books, and doing all of it from Accra.

item.title: Management Systems: The Silent Foundation Behind Every Thriving Venture

item.title: Why I moved from design to full-stack
item.description: The honest reason I stopped doing only design work and picked up PHP, MySQL, and server configuration.

item.title: Building AI-assisted workflows that actually ship
item.description: Nine AI certificates later, here is what I actually use day to day — and what I have quietly dropped.

item.title: What Ghana taught me about shipping software
item.description: Constraints do not block good products. They shape them. Notes from four years of building from Accra.

item.title: The LAMP stack is not dead — and Ghana knows it
item.description: A quiet case for the technology everyone loves to dismiss, from someone who ships it every week.

item.title: Designing for the one laptop that matters
item.description: What changes when you build for real users instead of benchmarks — bandwidth, old devices, and the discipline it teaches.

item.title: What running a studio taught me about shipping software
item.description: Clients, timelines, revisions, and the quiet craft of building things that outlive the meeting they came from.
